EARS notation in 4 steps: requirements Kiro can't misread

Four steps to write requirements nobody can misread.

1. Start with WHEN - Name the condition that triggers it.
2. Add the response - Then say what the system SHALL do.
3. One behavior each - Keep each requirement to a single behavior.
4. Let Kiro draft them - Kiro writes acceptance criteria in EARS for you.

Docs: https://kiro.dev/docs/specs/feature-specs/
